column1: # One verdict per API method. Hand-written; the method list beside it,
# testdata/api-methods.json, is not — `gates api-diff` writes that.
# The Chat API is bigger than the tool surface and grows without notice.
# This record is where that gap is a set of decisions: a method Google
# adds fails the build until somebody judges it, rather than arriving as
# Columns, tab-separated: api, method, verdict, reason. A verdict of
# `used` names the gchat.Client method that implements it; `out` gives
# the reason it is deliberately not used. Sorted by api and method.
# `gates api-coverage` holds this record, the method list and the client
# to each other, offline, in `make check`. `gates api-diff` refetches the
# discovery documents and rewrites the method list; it needs the network,
# so it is a target somebody runs rather than a gate CI depends on.
# The `openid` row has no discovery document behind it. It is the one
# OpenID Connect endpoint this server calls, to learn which account is
# signed in, and `apis` in scripts/gates/apicoverage.go says so.
